_comment: Copy to push-config.json at the repo root for desktop packaging. Keep AuthKey_*.p8 and serviceAccountKey.json gitignored beside it. scripts/build-desktop.sh and build-desktop.ps1 stage them into apps/tauri/src-tauri/resources/node/.
_comment_paths: keyPath and serviceAccountJsonPath may be absolute or relative. Relative paths resolve against the directory that contains push-config.json (repo root in dev, resources/node in a packaged app).
